claim_ceiling: The factory has produced a vertical-slice product with center_projected as the validated default representation (the only representation passing BOTH adversarial language dominance <0.85 AND jurist pairwise preference >0.5), 12 selectable map modes, user corpus import/export, and a 7-resolution fractal map with perfect hierarchical nesting. Core lanes have identified complementary legal signals (sachverhalt, erwaegungen, norms, citations, outcomes) that improve fine-grained legal relevance. A supervised metric learning frontier team is chartered to beat the unsupervised baseline. Full-corpus validation (~192k decisions) and jurist pairwise evaluation remain as the two critical paths to ACCEPTED-tier generalization claims. Claims NOT yet justified: Full TF 2000-2024 (~192k) generalization (corpus lane not complete); Jurist-validated map mode preferences (human study not executed); center_projected fractal-map reproduction (not yet run); Legal-distance signal ablation reproduction on center_projected (not yet run); Frontier metric learning superiority (not yet executed).

evaluation_v2.key_finding: center_projected is the FIRST and ONLY representation to pass BOTH critical adversarial tests: adversarial language dominance = 0.7593 (<0.85 threshold) and jurist pairwise preference = 0.5215 (>0.5 threshold). Also passes Jurivoc (4/5) and zoom coherence (+4.6%).

legal_distance_v4.key_finding: All 8 tested legal signals significantly improve fine-grained legal relevance over debiased_citation_blended baseline. Best single signals: sachverhalt_tfidf (fine_purity=0.986), norm_embeddings (fine_purity=0.974), erwaegungen+citations (fine_purity=0.971), hybrid_erwaegungen_07 (best trade-off: coarse=0.657, fine=0.915). Validated on fractal-map harness.

key_findings: Scale test (1,200 decisions): all v4 modes generalize; hybrid_erwaegungen_07 only hybrid improving coarse (+0.039) while gaining fine (+0.047)
Legal embeddings: multilingual-e5-small best multilingual (cross-lang=1.0) but low zoom (29%); xlm-roberta-base best zoom (93%) but language-sensitive
Citation role modeling: 2,988 annotations extracted (citing=2427, following=311, criticizing=174, distinguishing=58, overruling=18); blocked by BGE/ATF to decision_id mismatch
Jurist evaluation framework: complete protocol (200 questions, UI, stratified sampling, analysis plan); needs 5-10 Swiss jurists
Benchmark refinement: 37 -> 16 benchmarks; adversarial gates promoted to Tier 1

fractal_map.key_finding: Hierarchical Leiden achieves perfect nesting (1.0), purity=0.949, 7-resolution ladder (0.25 to 3.0), 59.2% zoom improvement rate. Validated on debiased_citation_blended — MUST REPRODUCE on center_projected.

product_v6.key_finding: Vertical slice COMPLETE: center_projected DEFAULT, 12 representations (5 new legal-distance signals + 4 section modes), user corpus import persistence operational, map export functional, 97/97 tests passing, 22 API endpoints.

corpus.key_finding: 1,577 canonical decisions (1000 slice 2000+ + 250/yr 2020-2024), 1,215 unique, 50+ Swiss laws mapped, citation graph 2105 refs, user import validated (JSONL/JSON/text, dedup, schema). OpenCaseLaw bulk ingestion for true TF 2000-2024 (~192k) and citation ID resolution pipeline remain.

frontier.methodology: Supervised metric learning (Mahalanobis/linear) on Jurivoc/TF weak labels vs core lane's unsupervised signal ablation
frontier.acceptance_test: Frozen: >=5% relative improvement on >=3/4 jurist proxies + no regression on zoom_coherence (>=0.39) or multilingual_invariance (lang_dom<0.85) + boilerplate_resistance PASS + serializable + meets center_projected on adversarial benchmarks
frontier.stop_promote_rule: PROMOTE if acceptance_test passes + temporal_stability (held-out 2024 mean_knn_score>=0.75). PAUSE if no improvement after 3 architecture variants. TERMINATE if collapse or multilingual_invariance violation.
